verdict.rationale: A business banking platform could reasonably offer a developer API for accounting data, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only native accounting-software sync (QuickBooks Online, Xero) and a Plaid connection. Those are prebuilt integrations, not a dedicated developer API to view and manage accounting data, and no API docs, endpoints or keys appear.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view and manage accounting data through a dedicated API
